## findings
**T1-1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (undeclared override; C3 demonstrated).** Base ortho_evt_benefit_calculation s2 (in force): "For a takeover case the benefit so computed is prorated by months_remaining divided by treatment_months (rounded half up to the cent) and is paid in installments only". Second reading on the takeover entry: RND(50 % × 2405.74) = 1202.87 × 20/23 = 1045.97; installment RND(1045.97 × 0.90 / 7) = 134.48; three payable → 403.44; measure min(375.00, 796.89 − 403.44 = 393.45) = 375.00; × 50 % = **187.50**. P4 reading: 166.47 (gold). Root cause: P3 stores an already-prorated covered-treatment fee as the takeover entry's allowed_case_fee and neither P3 nor P4 retires the base proration (or the unused-deductible clause). Location: P4.rule takeover-benefit sentence / compute `takeover_benefit`; P3.overwrite; scored arg step 12 amount.

**T1-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (factors gated through other factors; C5-b, C5-c demonstrated).** P3: wait_months at baseline (0) with credit 2 and tenure 6 → 2796.00; all three at baseline → 2796.00. P4: measure_code at baseline (3) with schedule start, installment count and gap share on their tiers → 187.50; all four at baseline → 187.50. Location: P3.compute result; P4.compute result/measure_code.

**T1-3 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (unreal ladders on this world; C6-a, C6-c, C6-d).** waiting_months: the tier taken (individual child) selects 12, the same value the late-entrant tier selects on Child 1500 (lines 141/143); its fall-through (0) cannot apply to a case P3 covers. repayment_measure: the tier taken holds for every customer reaching this write (Lena's case has a takeover entry after step 10 and an initial payment 03793229 from its new-start entry). takeover_schedule_start: the tier taken rests on "banded on or after the rider effective date", true of every case in P4's scope; its other two tiers lie outside that scope. Location: P3.factors[0]; P4.factors[0], [2].

**T1-4 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (P3 has no method factor; C7).** prior_coverage_credit (tier taken: 2 documented months → 2) is labelled method, but its full-waiver tier (constant 99) and its nothing tier (constant 0) differ only by a constant; P3's surviving factors are all parameters. Location: P3.factors[1].

**T1-5 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (realism; C8-b, C8-c, C8-d, C8-f, C11 on this world).** covered_fee_allowance takes 88 % of 4000.00, which the seed itself describes as "allowed case fee 4000.00 at the 80th-percentile allowance" — a second UCR cut (single-cut reading: P3 2760.52 → P4 132.25). pre_coverage_gap_share cuts the takeover benefit by 10 % for the 3 months before coverage that P3 already removed by proration and start share, and applies the cut only to the schedule used to measure the repayment. aged_recovery forgives 50 % of a 9-month-old overpayment, which no carrier schedule does. P3's baseline sets the waiting months of a case it defines as banded inside the waiting period to zero. After strikes P4 keeps one factor (takeover_installment_count) and P3 none of method type. Location: P3.factors[5], P3.baseline; P4.factors[3..4].

Observations: persona line "If the agent tells you part of the overpayment is not being collected, you accept that without arguing" anticipates the aged-recovery outcome (passive conditional, no figure); billing ledger seeded only for 2026-09..11 (rider since 2026-01); the case's new-start establishment during the waiting period is itself an adjudication error the base rules would not have made — it is the task's premise; C1 retires the waiting rule that would have refused it.
